title: 5 signs your phone is running your nights
format: Notes listicle, app on one point
why: Self-diagnosis listicle (amayareading shape): readers count how many apply, save it, and comment their score. The app is the fix on the last sign.
caption: be honest in the comments #screentime #phoneaddiction #sleep
check: closer: 'i had all 5'. Only if true for you

slides.title: 5 signs your phone is the one running your nights

slides.heading: you check the time at _1:27_
slides.top: you planned to sleep at 11. you _always_ plan to sleep at 11
slides.text:
the hours don't feel like hours on a feed

they feel like _one more_

slides.heading: you need _something playing_
slides.text:
a video to fall asleep to, a podcast to wake up to

your brain forgot how to be _bored_

slides.heading: you unlock it and _forget why_
slides.top: you stare at the home screen for a second, then open instagram _anyway_
slides.text:
your thumb knows the way before you decide anything

that's not a choice. it's a _reflex_

slides.heading: _tired all day_, wide awake at midnight
slides.text:
the second wind isn't energy

it's the feed _keeping you up_

slides.heading: mornings start _horizontal_
slides.top: the phone is the first thing you touch, _before your feet hit the floor_
slides.text:
and the day starts with everyone else's lives

i fixed this one by making my apps _wait until i'm walking_

slides.question: how many did you get? be honest 👇
lines: the app is locturne, link in bio
